canonical_statement: For probability measures mu and nu on compact metric Borel spaces and a continuous real-valued cost c, the infimum of the cost integral over probability couplings equals the supremum of the integrals of signed continuous real potentials phi and psi satisfying phi(x) + psi(y) <= c(x,y).
domain_and_universes: universes u v; compact metric spaces X : Type u and Y : Type v with explicit measurable structures satisfying BorelSpace; probability measures mu and nu; continuous c : X x Y -> Real
conclusion: sInf of real Bochner-integral costs over probability couplings equals sSup of the real integral objectives over signed continuous feasible potential pairs
minimal_import_evidence: Bochner.Basic alone does not expose ProbabilityMeasure (negative probe: unknown identifier); ProbabilityMeasure alone does not supply integral notation and Bochner integration, so both direct imports represent the two used API surfaces.
historical_candidate_relationship: The historical AwesomeTheorems.Stage1.S1_M_169.CompactMetricStatementShape is deliberately not transported: it quantifies lower-semicontinuous ENNReal costs, uses nonnegative measurable ENNReal potentials, and concludes Nonempty of an auxiliary data package. These are not equivalent by unfolding to this signed-real equality.

killed: changed the cost codomain to ENNReal

degenerate_cases: Empty carrier types cannot support a ProbabilityMeasure, so no separate Nonempty binder is added. Zero cost admits the signed zero potential pair by a kernel-checked constructor. Constant costs, Dirac marginals, and singleton spaces remain admitted without extra hypotheses.
status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates the intake-selected target only. It proves neither weak nor strong Kantorovich duality and gives no credit to later rev-5.6 nodes.
